build_lob_detector: build a detect-secrets plugin using LobDetector to scan codebases for Lob API secrets
review_secret_type: review the LobDetector secret_type property that returns the string Lob Secret
review_denylist: review the LobDetector denylist property containing regex patterns for Lob API keys and publishable keys
test_lob_api_key_regex: test the LobDetector regex pattern that matches live or test Lob API keys with 35 hex characters
test_lob_publishable_key_regex: test the LobDetector regex pattern that matches live or test Lob publishable keys with 31 hex characters
